name: hei5enbug-agent-setup
description: Portable agent skills for repeatable engineering and documentation workflows.

agent_guard.title: Block built-in subagents
agent_guard.description: Hide the built-in general-purpose, Explore, Plan, and claude agents and deny forked subagents so work goes to the plugin's scout, worker, and researcher agents.

session_approval.title: One-time session approval
session_approval.description: Approve each covered outward write (git tags, tag pushes, gh release create or edit, MCP write tools, and Codex worker access to a directory outside the session folder) once per session; destructive or unverifiable actions always ask.

role_pinning.title: Pin role models
role_pinning.description: Run the scout, worker, researcher, and designer agents on their pinned model and effort, and stop an agent that runs on any other model.

codex_worker.title: Codex implementation worker
codex_worker.description: Run implementation workers through Codex on gpt-6-luna at xhigh effort; turn off to use the Sonnet worker.

language_guard.title: Response language guard
language_guard.description: Block or remind when a reply is not written in the configured response language.

datagrip_guard.title: DataGrip query guard
datagrip_guard.description: Run read-only DataGrip queries without approval and ask for anything that writes or cannot be classified.
